plugins.name: feature-workflow
plugins.description: Nine skills covering the feature lifecycle, from a Jira ticket key to a merged MR and a written-back ticket status: /ship-feature (ticket or brief → plan → build → MR → external review → fix → re-review until clean → conflicts → merge → ticket update; entry-state aware, crash-safe with --resume), /ticket-intake (Jira issue → numbered requirements, each with a verbatim quote, reconciling comments that supersede the description), /plan-feature (product-owner + architect planning with per-requirement coverage), /build-feature (disciplined plan execution ending in an MR/PR), /mr-review (independent external-AI reviews with context pack, static pre-pass, and delta re-review), /address-review (review-comment triage and resolution), /resolve-conflicts (merge-based conflict resolution that keeps review threads anchored, with per-class rules and a target-work check), /ticket-report (one Jira comment naming what shipped and what didn't, plus a transition that never claims Done on partial work), /land (post-merge landing runbook: pipelines, migrations, deploy order, canary verification)
